type:
∀ (L : ℕ) (I : Finset ℕ),
  (∀ x ∈ I, PaperP1.HomogeneousRunMass.probability L {x} ≤ 2 * (2 ^ L)⁻¹) →
    PaperP1.HomogeneousRunMass.probability L I ≤ 2 ^ I.card * PaperP1.PrimitiveNominalMass.weight L I
name: PaperP1.FixedArityHomogeneousMass.point_le_nominal

type:
∀ (L r : ℕ) (F : Finset (Finset ℕ)),
  (∀ I ∈ F, I.card = r) →
    (∀ I ∈ F, ∀ x ∈ I, PaperP1.HomogeneousRunMass.probability L {x} ≤ 2 * (2 ^ L)⁻¹) →
      ∑ I ∈ F, PaperP1.HomogeneousRunMass.probability L I ≤ 2 ^ r * PaperP1.PrimitiveNominalMass.mass F L
name: PaperP1.FixedArityHomogeneousMass.mass_le_nominal

binders.type: ∀ I ∈ F, ∀ x ∈ I, PaperP1.HomogeneousRunMass.probability L {x} ≤ 2 * (2 ^ L)⁻¹
binders.name: hcap

type:
∀ (C : ℝ),
  ∃ N₀,
    2 ≤ N₀ ∧
      ∀ N ≥ N₀,
        ∀ (L : ℕ),
          |↑L - Real.log ↑N / Real.log 2| ≤ C →
            0 < L ∧ ∀ x ∈ PaperP1.Model.dyadicBlock N, PaperP1.HomogeneousRunMass.probability L {x} ≤ 2 * (2 ^ L)⁻¹
name: PaperP1.FixedArityHomogeneousMass.uniform_nominal_cap

type:
∀ (L : ℕ),
  0 < L →
    ∀ (F : Finset (Finset ℕ)),
      (∀ I ∈ F, I.Nonempty) →
        ∑ I ∈ F, PaperP1.PrimitiveWindowMass.weight L I ≤ ∑ I ∈ F, PaperP1.HomogeneousRunMass.probability L I ∧
          ∑ I ∈ F, PaperP1.Model.InfiniteStarts.infiniteJointMoment L I ≤
              ∑ I ∈ F, PaperP1.HomogeneousRunMass.probability L I ∧
            ∑ I ∈ F, |PaperP1.Model.InfiniteStarts.infiniteCenteredCoefficient L I| ≤
              ∑ I ∈ F, PaperP1.HomogeneousRunMass.probability L I
name: PaperP1.FixedArityHomogeneousMass.finite_original_domination

type:
∀ (r : ℕ),
  3 ≤ r →
    ∀ (C ε : ℝ),
      0 < ε →
        ∃ N₀,
          3 ≤ N₀ ∧
            ∀ N ≥ N₀,
              ∀ (L : ℕ),
                |↑L - Real.log ↑N / Real.log 2| ≤ C →
                  ∀ (F : Finset (Finset ℕ)),
                    (∀ I ∈ F,
                        I ⊆ PaperP1.Model.dyadicBlock N ∧ I.card = r ∧ PaperP1.ConnectedWindowFamilies.Primitive L I) →
                      ∑ I ∈ F, PaperP1.HomogeneousRunMass.probability L I ≤ ↑N ^ (-↑r / 2 + ε)
name: PaperP1.FixedArityHomogeneousMass.uniform_mass

type:
∀ (r : ℕ),
  3 ≤ r →
    ∀ (C η ε : ℝ),
      0 < η →
        0 < ε →
          ∃ N₀,
            3 ≤ N₀ ∧
              ∀ N ≥ N₀,
                ∀ (L : ℕ),
                  |↑L - Real.log ↑N / Real.log 2| ≤ C →
                    ∀ (F : Finset (Finset ℕ)),
                      (∀ I ∈ F,
                          I ⊆ PaperP1.Model.dyadicBlock N ∧
                            I.card = r ∧
                              PaperP1.ConnectedWindowFamilies.Primitive L I ∧
                                η * ↑L ≤ ↑(PaperP1.Model.InfiniteStarts.runRelativeNullity L I)) →
                        ∑ I ∈ F, PaperP1.HomogeneousRunMass.probability L I ≤ ↑N ^ (1 - ↑r + ε)
name: PaperP1.FixedArityHomogeneousMass.uniform_dense_mass

type:
∀ (r : ℕ),
  3 ≤ r →
    ∀ (C η ε : ℝ),
      0 < η →
        0 < ε →
          ∃ N₀,
            3 ≤ N₀ ∧
              ∀ N ≥ N₀,
                ∀ (L : ℕ),
                  |↑L - Real.log ↑N / Real.log 2| ≤ C →
                    (∀ (F : Finset (Finset ℕ)),
                        (∀ I ∈ F,
                            I ⊆ PaperP1.Model.dyadicBlock N ∧
                              I.card = r ∧ PaperP1.ConnectedWindowFamilies.Primitive L I) →
                          ∑ I ∈ F, PaperP1.HomogeneousRunMass.probability L I ≤ ↑N ^ (-↑r / 2 + ε) ∧
                            ∑ I ∈ F, PaperP1.PrimitiveWindowMass.weight L I ≤ ↑N ^ (-↑r / 2 + ε) ∧
                              ∑ I ∈ F, PaperP1.Model.InfiniteStarts.infiniteJointMoment L I ≤ ↑N ^ (-↑r / 2 + ε) ∧
                                ∑ I ∈ F, |PaperP1.Model.InfiniteStarts.infiniteCenteredCoefficient L I| ≤
                                  ↑N ^ (-↑r / 2 + ε)) ∧
                      ∀ (F : Finset (Finset ℕ)),
                        (∀ I ∈ F,
                            I ⊆ PaperP1.Model.dyadicBlock N ∧
                              I.card = r ∧
                                PaperP1.ConnectedWindowFamilies.Primitive L I ∧
                                  η * ↑L ≤ ↑(PaperP1.Model.InfiniteStarts.runRelativeNullity L I)) →
                          ↑F.card ≤ ↑N ^ ε ∧
                            ∑ I ∈ F, PaperP1.HomogeneousRunMass.probability L I ≤ ↑N ^ (1 - ↑r + ε) ∧
                              ∑ I ∈ F, PaperP1.PrimitiveWindowMass.weight L I ≤ ↑N ^ (1 - ↑r + ε) ∧
                                ∑ I ∈ F, PaperP1.Model.InfiniteStarts.infiniteJointMoment L I ≤ ↑N ^ (1 - ↑r + ε) ∧
                                  ∑ I ∈ F, |PaperP1.Model.InfiniteStarts.infiniteCenteredCoefficient L I| ≤
                                    ↑N ^ (1 - ↑r + ε)
name: PaperP1.FixedArityHomogeneousMass.uniform_all_bounds
